page.overview:
Who is Dragon Fortress Guard?

The Dragon Fortress Guards, or simply Guards, are Adventurers Orient Expedition minifigures introduced in 2003.

Dragon Fortress Guards wear a dark grey circular hat and a set of light armour with dark grey torsos and black limbs. They also have a small dagger on their belts along with a pouch. Their armour and hat are decorated with symbols that appear to be the emblem of Emperor Chang Wu. Some of the guards carry earth orange quivers on their backs for holding arrows.

Dragon Fortress Guards are dozens of Chinese soldiers employed by the villainous Emperor Chang Wu to guard his Dragon Fortress in China. Due to Chang Wu's alliance with Lord Sam Sinister, they act as enemies of the heroic Adventurers, filling a similar role to the Palace Guards in India. They avoid patrolling the Passage of Jun-Chi due to being afraid of Jun-Chi.

In Episode 07, Guards arrest Johnny Thunder, Dr. Kilroy, and Pippin Reed when they arrive at the Great Wall of China. Pippin escapes the cell, knocks the Guards unconscious, and takes their keys. In Episode 08, Guards attempt to arrest the Adventurers and Jing Lee, but Jing Lee kicks over a stack of crates and knocks them out. In the online comics and magazine comics, Guards crew the Emperor's Ship captained by Lord Sinister, unaware of the Adventurers sneaking aboard. They capture the Adventurers when they sneak into the Dragon Fortress through the Passage of Jun-Chi, but they scatter and flee when Jun-Chi arrives. At the end of Episode 09, Guards are ordered to fire a catapult at the Adventurers as they drive away in their half-track. In 4215473 Die Suche nach dem Goldenen Drachen, the Guards are defeated by Chinese rebels.
